description_en: Retrieves the details of a deployment task
name: GetDeployment

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. For more information about how to obtain the workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间ID。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

Accessibility.description_en:
The workspace visibility. Valid values:
PRIVATE: Visible only to you and administrators in this workspace.
PUBLIC: Visible to everyone in this workspace
Accessibility.description_zh:
工作空间可见性，可能值为：
PRIVATE：在此工作空间中，仅对您和管理员可见。
PUBLIC：在此工作空间中，对所有人可见

AutoApproval.description_en: Specifies whether to automatically skip the deployment confirmation step
AutoApproval.description_zh: 是否自动跳过部署确认环节

ConnectionName.description_en: The connection name. This parameter is required when the conversation history storage method is set to RDS
ConnectionName.description_zh: 连接名称。对话历史存储方式为 RDS 的时候需要指定该参数

StorageType.description_en:
The storage method. Valid values:
LOCAL: Conversation history is saved in a local SQLite file. Multi-instance deployment is not supported.
OSS: Conversation history is saved in a specific path under the OSS working directory of the service.
RDS: Conversation history is saved in an ApsaraDB RDS table. An RDS connection must be specified
StorageType.description_zh:
存储方式。取值：
LOCAL: 对话历史保存在本地 SQLite 文件，不支持多实例的部署方式。
OSS：对话历史保存在服务 OSS 工作路径下特定的路径下。
RDS：对话历史保存在 RDS 的表中，需要指定一个 RDS 连接

EnableInputModeration.description_en: Specifies whether to enable security moderation for input content
EnableInputModeration.description_zh: 是否启用对输入的安全审查

EnableOutputModeration.description_en: Specifies whether to enable content moderation for output content
EnableOutputModeration.description_zh: 是否启用对输出的内容审查

StreamingModerationThreshold.description_en: The cache size for streaming output content moderation. Default value: 5
StreamingModerationThreshold.description_zh: 流式输出内容送审缓存大小，默认为 5
StreamingModerationThreshold.title_en: 流式输出内容送审缓存大小
StreamingModerationThreshold.title_zh: 流式输出内容送审缓存大小

DeploymentConfig.description_en: The deployment configuration. For more information, see Deployment configurations (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/pai/user-guide/parameters-of-model-services) in PAI-EAS
DeploymentConfig.description_zh: 部署配置。具体参考 PAI-EAS 的部署配置 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/pai/user-guide/parameters-of-model-services)

GmtEndTime.description_en: The end time of the deployment stage. The time is displayed in the ISO 8601 format and includes the time zone offset
GmtEndTime.description_zh: 部署阶段结束时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式并包含时区偏移

GmtStartTime.description_en: The start time of the deployment stage. The time is displayed in the ISO 8601 format and includes the time zone offset
GmtStartTime.description_zh: 部署阶段开始时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式并包含时区偏移

StageStatus.description_en:
The deployment stage status. Valid values:
NotStarted: Not started.
WaitForConfirm: Waiting for confirmation.
Waiting: Waiting.
Creating: Creating.
Running: Running.
Succeed: Succeeded.
Failed: Failed.
Canceled: Canceled
StageStatus.description_zh:
部署阶段状态。取值：
NotStarted： 未开始。
WaitForConfirm：等待确认。
Waiting： 等待中。
Creating： 创建中。
Running： 运行中。
Succeed： 成功。
Failed： 失败。
Canceled：取消

DeploymentStatus.description_en:
The deployment task status. Valid values:
Creating: Creating.
Failed: Failed.
Stopping: Stopping.
Waiting: Waiting.
Starting: Starting.
Running: Running.
Pending: Pending.
WaitForConfirm: Waiting for confirmation.
Canceled: Canceled.
Succeed: Succeeded
DeploymentStatus.description_zh:
部署任务状态。取值：
Creating：创建中。
Failed：部署失败。
Stopping：停止中。
Waiting：等待中。
Starting：启动中。
Running：运行中。
Pending：等待中。
WaitForConfirm: 等待确认。
Canceled：取消。
Succeed：成功

EnableTrace.description_en: Specifies whether Tracing Analysis is enabled

GmtCreateTime.description_en: The creation time in UTC, following the ISO 8601 standard
GmtCreateTime.description_zh: 创建时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式的 UTC 时间

GmtModifiedTime.description_en: The last modification time in UTC, following the ISO 8601 standard
GmtModifiedTime.description_zh: 最后修改时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式的 UTC 时间

OperationType.description_en:
The operation type. Valid values:
Create: Creates a service.
Update: Updates an existing service
OperationType.description_zh:
操作类型。取值：
Create： 新建服务。
Update： 更新已有服务

ResourceId.description_en: The ID of the resource to be deployed

ResourceSnapshotId.description_en: The snapshot ID of the resource to be deployed. If this parameter is provided, the system deploys the resource directly based on this snapshot. If this parameter is not provided, the system creates a new snapshot for the resource before deployment
ResourceSnapshotId.description_zh: 待部署资源的快照 ID。若提供该参数，系统将直接基于该快照进行部署；若未提供，系统会先为资源创建新快照，再执行部署

ResourceType.description_en:
The type of the resource to be deployed. Valid values:
Flow: A workflow project.
Code: A code-mode project
ResourceType.description_zh:
待部署的资源类型。取值：
Flow: 工作流的项目
Code: 代码模式的项目

ServiceName.description_en:
The service name. Format requirements:
Only lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_) are supported.
Must start with a letter.
Must be 1 to 45 characters in length
ServiceName.description_zh:
服务名字。格式要求：
支持小写字母、数字和下划线
必须以字母开头
长度1-45个字符

WorkDir.description_en: The OSS working directory of the service. It is used to store service runtime logs, conversation history, and other data
WorkDir.description_zh: 服务的OSS工作目录。用于存储服务的运行日志、对话历史等

v1_parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. For more information about how to obtain the workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
v1_parameters.help_zh: 工作空间ID。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
v1_parameters.name: WorkspaceId
